    • com.pos.ItemSalesPane
      Modifier and Type
      Constant Field
      Value
      static final String
      ITEM_SALES_SQL
      "SELECT m.item_id, m.name, m.category,\n COALESCE(s.quantity_sold, 0) AS quantity_sold,\n COALESCE(s.revenue, 0) AS revenue\nFROM menu_item m\nLEFT JOIN (\n SELECT oi.item_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity_sold,\n SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue\n FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id\n WHERE o.order_time >= ? AND o.order_time < ?\n GROUP BY oi.item_id\n) s ON s.item_id = m.item_id\nORDER BY quantity_sold DESC, m.name, m.item_id\n"
    • com.pos.ProductUsageView
      Modifier and Type
      Constant Field
      Value
      static final String
      USAGE_SQL
      "SELECT i.inventory_id, i.name, i.unit,\n COALESCE(u.amount_used, 0) AS amount_used\nFROM inventory i\nLEFT JOIN (\n SELECT r.inventory_id,\n SUM(CAST(oi.quantity AS BIGINT) * r.quantity) AS amount_used\n FROM orders o\n JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id\n JOIN recipe r ON r.item_id = oi.item_id\n WHERE o.order_time >= ? AND o.order_time < ?\n GROUP BY r.inventory_id\n) u ON u.inventory_id = i.inventory_id\nWHERE (? IS NULL OR i.inventory_id = ?)\nORDER BY i.name, i.inventory_id\n"
